articles.title: Staff lottery reveals Apple's first-half September event plans

Selected workers will greet and check in guests, organize lines, provide directions and support security teams. Applications close August 8, and Apple will notify selected employees by August 17. Workers who participated in WWDC 2026 or the 2025 iPhone launch aren't eligible. iPhone 18 concept image Retail employees have supported major Apple Events for years, so the staffing program itself isn't new.
